semiconductor_relevance: High — MNE Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced sealing solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MNE Co., Ltd., now part of Trelleborg Sealing Solutions, develops and manufactures high-value-added seals, including FFKM and FKM O-rings and CMP components. Their products are designed to meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor fabrication, ensuring reliability and performance in high-temperature and chemically aggressive environments.

regional_presence.Korea: MNE Co., Ltd. will showcase its innovative sealing solutions at SEMICON Korea 2026, indicating a strategic presence in the region.
